ja478:1.1: Dūte te brahme pāhesiṃ Gaṅgātīrasmiṃ jhāyato, tesaṃ puṭṭho na vyāhāsi, dukkhaṃ guyha mataṃ nu te.
ja478:2.1: Sace te dukkhaṃ uppajji Kāsīnaṃ raṭṭhavaddhana mā kho no tassa akkhāhi yo taṃ dukkhā na mocaye.
ja478:3.1: Yo ca tathā dukkhajātassa ekantam api bhāsato vippamoceyya dhammena kāmaṃ tassa pavedaya.
ja478:4.1: Suvijānaṃ sigālānaṃ sakuntānaṅ ca vassitaṃ (= supra 217|6) manussavassitaṃ rāja dubbijānataraṃ tato.
ja478:5.1: Api ce maññatī poso ‘ñātimitto' ‘sakhā' ti vā (= supra 217|8) yo pubbe sumano hutvā pacchā sampajjate diso.
ja478:6.1: Yo attano dukkham anānupuṭṭho pavedaye jantu akālarūpe ānandino tassa bhavant' amittā hitesino tassa dukhī bhavanti.
ja478:7.1: Kālañ ca ñatvāna tathāvidhassa medhāvinaṃ ekamanaṃ viditvā akkheyya tippāni parassa dhīro, saṇhaṃ giraṃ atthavatiṃ pamuñce.
ja478:8.1: Sace ca jaññā avisayhaṃ attano ‘nāyaṃ nīti mayha sukhāgamāya' eko va tippāni sahetha dhīro saccaṃ hirottappam apekkhamāno ti.
ja478:9.1: Ahaṃ raṭṭhāni vicaranto nigame rājadhāniyo bhikkhamāno mahārāja ācariyassa dhanatthiko
ja478:10.1: Gahapatī rājapurise mahāsāle ca brāhmaṇe alatthaṃ satta nikkhāni suvaṇṇassa janādhipa, te me naṭṭhā mahārāja, tasmā socām' ahaṃ bhusaṃ.
ja478:11.1: Purisā te mahārāja manasānuvicintitā nālaṃ dukkhā pamocetuṃ, tasmā tesaṃ na vyāhariṃ.
ja478:12.1: Tvañ ca kho me mahārāja manasānuvicintito alaṃ dukkhā pamocetuṃ, tasmā tuyhaṃ pavedayin
ja478:13.1: ti. Tassādāsi pasannatto Kāsīnaṃ raṭṭhavaddhano jātarūpamaye nikkhe suvaṇṇassa catuddasā 'ti.
